title: Agents cannot dispatch a generation - add a generation.submit connector capability
description: The local HTTP API on 127.0.0.1:3000 can read projects, write card notes and project notes, enhance a prompt, read Pod stats and shut the app down, but no route reaches dispatch. Dispatch lives in the renderer (generationService.startGeneration, commandExecutor, generationStore, PromptBox), so an agent cannot start a generation or create a gallery card. POSTing a graph straight to /proxy/prompt runs on the engine and produces nothing in the UI: the picture lands on disk and the project never learns it exists, which also means no history entry, no sidecar and no Card notes. Add a generation.submit connector capability beside the existing prompt.enhance / system.memory.release / system.shutdown so a submitted job goes through the same path the PromptBox uses and lands as a real gallery card. The Playwright/Electron harness in tests/desktop/ is not an alternative - it launches its own Electron instance and cannot drive an app the user already has open. Blocks agent-driven production work; found while producing the Cubric western film, where every generation has to be run by hand. Also the prerequisite for the Cubric CLI direction.
